items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: BitMine Adds 28,086 ETH as Treasury Nears 5% of Supply
items.summary: The company valued its 5.93 million ETH at about $14.79 billion, while aggregate reported holdings rose to $15.7 billion from $15.6 billion a week earlier.

items.title: Robinhood Takes Stakes In Crypto.com And OG.com, Routes Football Contracts To Their Exchange
items.summary: Robinhood began sending a selection of football event contracts to Crypto.com's CFTC-regulated exchange on Tuesday and will hold stakes in both Crypto.com and OG.com, the prediction-market venue being spun out of it at a $5 billion valuation.
